user.title: EVN CSKH account
user.description: Sign in with your account from the official unified EVN CSKH application. All linked customers are initially selected; change this in the integration options. Requires Home Assistant 2025.12 or newer.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EVN CSKH
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the credentials for the same account. Complete any required account verification or password change in the official EVN application first.

error.invalid_username: Enter a username or phone number.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check your account credentials.
error.cannot_connect: The EVN service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: EVN returned an unsupported or invalid response. Try again later.
error.user_action_required: Complete account verification or change the default password in the official EVN application before signing in here.
error.wrong_account: Use the same username as the existing integration account.
error.unknown: The EVN operation failed. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This EVN account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this EVN account is already in progress.
abort.no_customers: No linked customers were returned. Link a customer in the official EVN application first.
abort.wrong_account: The account does not match the existing integration.

init.title: EVN CSKH polling and customers
init.description: Select at least one authorized customer, identified as management unit:customer code. Only selected customers are polled. Usage is reported for each measurement point. Outstanding amounts follow the app's unpaid-invoice summary; missing records are not proof of payment. Scheduled outages do not indicate the physical grid state.

error.invalid_interval: Use a whole number between 60 and 1440 minutes.
error.invalid_customer: Select only customers linked to this account.

auth_failed.message: EVN authentication failed. Reauthenticate this integration.

user_action_required.message: Complete the account action in the official EVN application, then reauthenticate.

no_customers.message: No linked customers remain. Link a customer in the official EVN application, then reauthenticate.

customer_removed.message: A selected customer is no longer linked to this account. Review the selected customers in the options or reauthenticate.

invalid_selection.message: Select at least one authorized customer in the integration options.

invalid_interval.message: Set an update interval of 60 to 1440 whole minutes in the options.
